headline: Actress Pori Moni gets bail after surrendering in assault case
summary: The popular actress surrendered to a Dhaka court and was granted bail in a case filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud. The case involves allegations of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.
details: Actress Pori Moni has been granted bail by a Dhaka court after she surrendered in connection with a case. The case was filed by businessman Nasir Uddin Mahmud, who accused her of assault, vandalism, and intimidation.

The acting judge of Dhaka Judicial Magistrate Court-1, Mahfuzur Rahman, approved her bail request following a hearing on Thursday. Pori Moni's lawyer, Nilanjana Rifat Suravi, confirmed the development.
The actress had previously been arrested and faced legal proceedings in another case related to drug charges, which also saw significant media attention.
caption:

The acting judge of Dhaka Judicial Magistrate Court-1, Mahfuzur Rahman, approved her bail request following a hearing on Thursday. Pori Moni's lawyer, Nilanjana Rifat Suravi, confirmed the development.

The actress had previously been arrested and faced legal proceedings in another case related to drug charges, which also saw significant media attention.

headline_marked: Tourism resumes: [[First ship of the season sails]] for St Martin’s Island
headline: Tourism resumes: First ship of the season sails for St Martin’s Island
summary: After a 10-month hiatus, tourist vessels have begun operating again, marking the start of the new travel season to the coral island.
details: The first tourist ship of the new season has officially set sail for St Martin’s Island, ending a long wait for travelers.
According to reports, this marks the return of tourist vessels to the island after a gap of 10 months.
The ship, M.V. Baro Awlia of the Karnafuly Cruise Line, was among the first to transport passengers to the destination.
St Martin's is Bangladesh's only coral island and a major tourist attraction, typically seeing a surge in visitors during the winter months.
caption:
After 10 months, the ships are back! 🚢

Tourist vessels have officially resumed sailing to St Martin’s Island.

The first tourist ship of the new season has officially set sail for St Martin’s Island, ending a long wait for travelers.

According to reports, this marks the return of tourist vessels to the island after a gap of 10 months.

The ship, M.V. Baro Awlia of the Karnafuly Cruise Line, was among the first to transport passengers to the destination.

St Martin's is Bangladesh's only coral island and a major tourist attraction, typically seeing a surge in visitors during the winter months.
